scenario_description: Controlled high-discharge spillway release from Kosi Barrage (Bhimnagar gates) during monsoon peak reservoir conditions.

solver.scheme: explicit 2D Lax-Friedrichs finite-volume, point-implicit Manning friction

sanity_checks.name: mass_conservation
sanity_checks.detail: Volume on grid at final step (125,940,047 m³) vs. total volume injected (125,940,000 m³): +0.00% delta.

sanity_checks.name: nontrivial_flood_extent
sanity_checks.detail: Simulated max flood extent is 3.32% of AOI (206.4 km²).

sanity_checks.name: extent_not_saturated
sanity_checks.detail: Simulated max flood extent is 3.32% of the AOI. Domain is not saturated.

assumptions: Manning's n = 0.035 uniform roughness across the domain
Inflow hydrograph: linear ramp 0 -> peak over 10.0 min, then held at peak discharge (12000.0 m³/s)
Breach location (26.5263°N, 86.9269°E), bed elevation sampled at 77.8m
Open (zero-gradient) boundary conditions on all domain boundaries
Dry-bed initial condition (h=0m) representing floodwater advancement over terrain
SRTM DEM resampled to ~166m x 186m grid for computational stability and performance

terminology.population_metric: Population potentially exposed within simulated flood extent
terminology.disclaimer: These metrics represent model-estimated scenario exposures derived from spatial intersection of 2D SWE flood depth grids against WorldPop 2020 raster data and OpenStreetMap settlement centroids. They are scenario estimates for disaster planning and decision support, not confirmed casualties or ground truth.

spatial_operations: Point-in-grid continuous bilinear and cell sampling for settlement coordinates
Area-average zonal raster reprojection from ~185m SWE grid to ~1km WorldPop grid
Continuous arrival time tracking per grid cell: min(t) where depth >= 0.1m
Time-dependent timestep zonal evaluation vs. maximum extent union
datasets_missing: Road network vectors (requires OSM Highway layer)
Critical facility footprints (hospitals, schools, power, railways)
